rca of the issue: Original user report (404 on /api/mcqs/history followed by empty My Notes) could NOT be reproduced against the current build in this iteration or in iteration_2. The two contributing factors that would cause the 'notes disappear' symptom, both now fixed by main agent, are: (1) api.js response interceptor previously redirected to /login on ANY non-2xx and cleared localStorage — now only on 401 (verified in /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js line 19). (2) Notes.jsx load() had no try/catch, so a rejected /api/notes call would leave notes=[] silently — now wrapped in try/catch with a toast. Additionally, delete_note previously cascade-deleted MCQs, which would have made the reported 'my history is gone too' symptom irreversible; that cascade has been removed (server.py:242 'Preserve MCQs in history — do NOT cascade delete'). The one residual defect I found and fixed while verifying was that History.jsx invoked toast.error inside its catch block without importing toast — this would have thrown a ReferenceError swallowing the user-facing error message on a real 404. All routes /api/notes, /api/notes/upload, /api/mcqs/history, /api/mcqs/chapters, /api/mcqs/session/{id}, /api/mcqs/generate, /api/mcqs/generate-mixed, /api/mcqs/{id}/answer, /api/progress, /api/auth/me are confirmed to return 200 for an authenticated user (see test_api_contract.py::test_no_404_on_any_frontend_route).
